description: Save something the user wants every AI to know, in their Foundaree Memory: preferences, facts about them or their business, how they like things written ("my shop opens 9 to 7", "write in a friendly, short style", "my audience is small shops in Kochi"). Any assistant they connect to Foundaree can read it later with recall. Save only what the user asked to remember or clearly agreed to, one idea per note, in their words. Never save passwords, PINs, one-time codes, keys or card numbers: they are refused. They can see, edit and delete everything at https://foundaree.com/memory. Needs the user to have connected their Foundaree account.

note.description: What to remember, as a short sentence or two.

topic.description: An optional one- or two-word topic to group it, e.g. "business", "writing style", "family".

name: remember
title: Save a note for all your AIs
